The <b>Pollen Heart</b> is a [[Items_(Silksong)#Deliverables|deliverable item]] and [[Materium#Mementos|memento]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== Use ==

The Pollen Heart is used along with the [[Encrusted Heart]], the [[Hunter's Heart]], and/or the [[Conjoined Heart]] to complete the <i>[[SEEK: The Old Hearts]]</i> [[Objectives|objective]].

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Red Memory.png!Snail Shamans location in Moss Grotto
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Snail Shamans 01.png!Snail Shamans in the Ruined Chapel in Moss Grotto
}}

If the Pollen Heart is obtained afterwards, as a fourth heart, then it becomes a [[memento]] that can be displayed on a shelf in the [[Bellhome]]. After interacting with the desk, it appears in the top-middle slot of the shelving.

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Bellhome.png!Location in Bellhart
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Pollen Heart 02.png!Displayed inside Bellhome in Bellhart
}}

== How to Acquire ==
The Pollen Heart is acquired after defeating [[Nyleth]] in a hidden area in [[Shellwood]], accessed through a breakable wall in the [[Grand Gate]]'s lift shaft.

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Nyleth.png!Location in Grand Gate
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Pollen Heart 01.png!Pollen Heart on Nyleth's fountain in Grand Gate
}}
